purpose: Allow already-open durable-task chats to adopt the current Universal Continuity protocol without user-managed migration or unnecessary lease takeover.
applies_to: already-open chats with an active durable task
tasks inherited under an older Continuity protocol
owner manifests whose Universal protocol metadata is older than the current protocol
trigger: before the next material checkpoint or final durable-task response when current protocol/owner authority is available
flow: Read the current Universal Continuity protocol and reconciliation policy.
Read the task's authoritative manifest and owner checkpoint without relying on chat memory.
Determine the persisted Continuity protocol version, including legacy contract_version conventions.
Classify compatibility using VERSION_LIFECYCLE_POLICY.json plus owner compatibility evidence.
If COMPATIBLE and metadata is current, continue normally.
If MIGRATABLE through an additive supported edge, update protocol metadata/adaptation record in place without changing business state or replaying work.
Preserve the existing active_lease and resume_epoch when the same chat remains the valid writer.
Re-read the authoritative manifest/checkpoint and verify the reconciliation write.
Apply the current PROGRESS_OBSERVABILITY_POLICY.json to the final response.
If INCOMPATIBLE or UNKNOWN, fail closed for durable mutation and route through an explicit migration/fresh-handoff path.

progress_receipt_in_existing_chats.reason: Resume Progress Receipt is a takeover boundary receipt. Existing chats adopt the new per-turn commit receipt without pretending a new resume occurred.

degraded_mode.current_protocol_unavailable: Continue read-only/explanatory work when safe, but do not claim migration or COMMITTED durable progress.
degraded_mode.owner_authority_unavailable: COMMIT_FAILED for material durable change; do not use a cache as proof.
degraded_mode.unsupported_old_protocol: UNKNOWN_OR_INCOMPATIBLE; fail closed and require an explicit migration path, not user reconstruction.
